s01.bounds_basis: NON-HENDERSON synthetic generator specification: bounded dimensionless values in [0,1].

s02.bounds_basis: NON-HENDERSON synthetic generator specification: bounded dimensionless values in [0,1].

timestamp.basis: NON-HENDERSON synthetic UTC clock: simultaneous paired records with an arbitrary origin and one-minute spacing.

acquisition.basis: NON-HENDERSON fixture: one generated paired draw per source record in one export; no copied acquisitions, re-exports, averaging, holding, interpolation, deadband, filtering or resampling. Six-decimal rounding is the only value transformation.

grouping.basis: NON-HENDERSON test-only hypothetical acquisition model: each paired draw is an independently initiated acquisition with no shared residual dependence. This declaration exercises the interface; it is not an empirical independence finding.

independence_basis: NON-HENDERSON fixture assumption: independent bounded draws conditional on one fixed context and schedule. Deterministic pseudorandom values exercise the contract and do not establish independence for real telemetry.

schedule.basis: NON-HENDERSON fixture: fixed 112-record export and acquisition schedule; no value-based retention or outcome-based selection.

context.basis: NON-HENDERSON hypothetical homogeneous acquisition population using the same generator and bounds throughout.

plan.basis: NON-HENDERSON dry-run design fixed before analysis: all records partitioned chronologically; a hypothetical seven-minute operating coverage period, unrelated to any incident. This is not a real operating-cycle claim.
